reason: B more directly exploits the FCC/BCC architecture and advances a testable extension—interphase coherency as the governing creep barrier—rather than largely repeating the cited dynamic-precipitation result for a single-phase FCC alloy. Its processing comparison needs tighter control of phase fraction, grain size, and precipitates, and its falsification rule should treat confirmed coherency without reduced creep rate as decisive falsification, but it remains the more novel and relevant proposal.
